webster.text: The act of lessening; a making smaller; opposed to augmentation; as the diminution of size, of wealth, of power, of safety.

more.text: Deprivation of dignity; a lessening of estimation.
In music, the imitation of or reply to a subject in notes of half the length or value of those of the subject itself.

example.quote: This done, they will have no power to alter it, either by increase or diminution, till a new period of service by a new election commences.
